title: Your list
mode: How do you want to add the list?
pasteHint: Copy the cells from Excel or Google Sheets, including the heading row, and paste them here. A CSV text works too.
chooseFile: Choose a CSV or Excel file
fileHint: Works with .xlsx and .csv. Old .xls files: open them in Excel and use Save as .xlsx or .csv first. The file is read on your device and never uploaded.
helpRules: Put the headings in the first row, one heading for each column.
Put one person or item on each row, with nothing in between.
Keep it to one table: no merged cells, no totals row at the bottom, no pictures.
In Excel, leave the file on the sheet you want to use first, or pick the sheet below after you add it.
Phone numbers and roll numbers that start with 0: format that column as Text before you type them, or Excel drops the zero.
helpSample: A sample sheet looks like this:
readTitle: What we read from your list
headingsGuess: We think the first row is a heading row.
noHeadingsGuess: The first row looks like data, not headings. Tick the box if it is a heading row.
checkRows: First rows and last rows, so you can check the start and the end
mapHint: We matched these by their headings. Change any that look wrong.
warnMerged: The sheet has {n} merged cells. Merged cells can hide values. Unmerge them and fill every row if something looks missing.
warnHiddenRows: The sheet has {n} hidden rows. They are included here. Delete them in Excel if you do not want them.
warnHiddenSheets: The file has {n} hidden sheet(s). Only the sheet named above is read.
warnFormulas: {n} formula cells had no saved result, so they were read as empty. Open the file in Excel, save it, and add it again.
warnErrors: {n} cells contained Excel errors (like #N/A) and were read as empty.
warnDates: {n} date cells were read as day-month-year, for example 26-11-2026.
warnDuplicates: {n} rows are exact copies of an earlier row.
warnTruncated: Only the first {max} rows are used.
warnEncoding: The file was not UTF-8, so it was read as Windows text. If names look odd, save the CSV as UTF-8 and add it again.
allGood: No problems found. Compare the rows above with your sheet to be sure.

errors.tooBig: This file is bigger than 10 MB. Remove extra columns or split it.
errors.oldXls: This is an old .xls file. Open it in Excel, choose Save as, pick Excel Workbook (.xlsx) or CSV, and add that file.
errors.notXlsx: This does not look like an .xlsx or CSV file. Save it as .xlsx or CSV and try again.
errors.empty: We found no data in this list.
errors.unreadable: This file could not be read. Save it as .xlsx or CSV and try again.

warnTotals: {n} row(s) start with the word Total. They will be treated as people or items. Delete them from your sheet if they are not.
